abilities.name: Grotesque Regeneration
abilities.description: At the end of each phase, if a Beasts of Nurgle model in this unit has lost any wounds but is not destroyed, that model regains all of its lost wounds.

abilities.name: Foul Infusion
abilities.description: While this model is leading a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. In addition, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.

abilities.name: Extraction of Fresh Disease
abilities.description: The first time this model's unit destroys an enemy unit as the result of a melee attack, until the end of the battle, add 6 to the Objective Control characteristic of this model.

leader.note: You can attach this model to a Plague Marines unit, even if one other Leader unit has already been attached to it (you cannot attach more than one of the same leader to the same unit). If you do, and that Bodyguard unit is destroyed, the Leader units attached to it become separate units, with their original Starting Strengths.

abilities.name: Assault Ramp
abilities.description: Each time a unit disembarks from this model after it has made a Normal move, that unit is still eligible to declare a charge this turn.

degradation.effect: Each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

transport.note: This transport has a capacity of 14 Death Guard Infantry models. Each Terminator model takes up the space of 2 models.

abilities.name: Fire Support
abilities.description: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly model that disembarked from this Transport this turn makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

transport.note: This model has a transport capacity of 12 Death Guard Infantry models. It cannot transport Terminator models.

abilities.name: Death Guard Defenders
abilities.description: While this model is within 3" of one or more friendly Death Guard Infantry units, this model has the Lone Operative ability.

abilities.name: Fevered Strategist
abilities.description: Once per battle round, one model from your army with this ability can use it when a friendly Death Guard unit within 12" of that model is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP.

abilities.name: Miasma of Pestilence (Aura)
abilities.description: While a friendly Death Guard unit is within 6" of this model, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

name: Daemon Prince of Nurgle with Wings

models.model: Daemon Prince of Nurgle with Wings

abilities.name: Horrifying Visage
abilities.description: Each time this model ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it. That unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

abilities.name: Enfeebling Miasma (Aura)
abilities.description: While an enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) is within 6" of this model, each time that unit is selected to Fall Back, models in that enemy unit must take Desperate Escape tests. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.

abilities.name: Silent Bodyguard
abilities.description: While a Character model is leading this unit, that Character model has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

abilities.name: Death Approaches
abilities.description: In your Movement phase, when this unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all Afflicted enemy units, and more than 9" horizontally away from all other enemy units.

wargearAbilities.name: Icon of Despair
wargearAbilities.description: While an enemy unit is within 6" of the bearer, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1.

abilities.name: Hovering Death
abilities.description: This model is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

name: Foetid Bloat-Drone with Heavy Blight Launcher
keywords: Foetid Bloat-Drone with Heavy Blight Launcher

abilities.name: Explosive Blight
abilities.description: In your Shooting phase, each time this model makes an attack that destroys an enemy unit, before removing the last model in that unit from play, roll a D6, adding 1 to the result if that unit is Afflicted: on a 5+, each enemy unit within 6" of that model is Afflicted until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Daemon Lord of Nurgle
abilities.description: While a friendly Plague Legions unit is within 6" of this model, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit.

abilities.name: Nurgle's Rot
abilities.description: At the end of your Movement phase, you can select one enemy unit within 12" of this model. Until the start of your next Movement phase, that unit is rotted. While a unit is rotted, subtract 1 from the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit.

wargearAbilities.name: Reverberating Summons
wargearAbilities.description: Each time a model is destroyed by this weapon, you can select one friendly Plaguebearers unit within 12" of the bearer and return 1 destroyed Plaguebearer model to that unit.

degradation.effect: Each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Vector of Disease
abilities.description: While this model is leading a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [LANCE] abilities.

abilities.name: Unholy Resilience
abilities.description: The first time a model with this ability is destroyed in a battle round, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set that model back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with 3 wounds remaining. Each model can only be set up in this way once per battle.

name: Mortarion

abilities.name: Lord of the Death Guard
abilities.description: Once per turn, this model can use one of the Lord of the Death Guard abilities.

subAbilities.name: Diseased Influence
subAbilities.description: Just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 9" of a friendly Death Guard unit that is within 6" of this model, if that Death Guard unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 5".

subAbilities.name: Boon of Death
subAbilities.description: In the Fight phase, when a friendly Death Guard unit within 6" of this model is selected as the target of an attack, this model can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that Death Guard unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 2+, do not remove it from play; that destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and it is then removed from play.

subAbilities.name: Inflamed Reprisal
subAbilities.description: In your opponent's Shooting phase, when a friendly Death Guard unit within 6" of this model is selected as the target of an attack, this model can use this ability. If it does, after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, that Death Guard unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).

abilities.name: Host of Plagues
abilities.description: At the end of your Movement phase, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of this model, adding 1 to the result if that enemy unit is Afflicted: on a 3+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

degradation.effect: Each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

supremeCommander: If this model is in your army, it must be your Warlord.

abilities.name: Tank Hunters
abilities.description: In your Shooting phase, each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets a Monster or Vehicle unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Mischief Makers
abilities.description: Each time an enemy unit (excluding Titanic units) within Engagement Range of one or more units with this ability is selected to fight, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes a melee attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Infected Outbreak
abilities.description: At the end of your Command phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

wargearAbilities.name: Daemonic Icon
wargearAbilities.description: Models in the bearer's unit have a Leadership characteristic of 6+.

wargearAbilities.name: Instrument of Chaos
wargearAbilities.description: Add 1 to Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

abilities.name: Death's Heads
abilities.description: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the turn, each time a friendly Plague Legions unit makes an attack that targets that unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

wargearAbilities.name: Daemonic Icon
wargearAbilities.description: Models in the bearer's unit have a Leadership characteristic of 6+.

wargearAbilities.name: Instrument of Chaos
wargearAbilities.description: Add 1 to Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

abilities.name: Spore-laced Shock Waves
abilities.description: In your Shooting phase, each time you select a target for this model's Plagueburst mortar, roll one D6 for the target unit and every other enemy unit within 3" of the target unit, adding 1 to that roll if the unit being rolled for is Afflicted. On a 6+, the unit being rolled for is struck by spores; after resolving all of this model's attacks against the target unit, each unit struck by spores suffers D3 mortal wounds.

degradation.effect: While this model has 1-4 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Infused with the Blessings of Nurgle
abilities.description: In your Shooting phase, you can target enemy units within Engagement Range of this unit with ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit (provided no other friendly units are within Engagement Range of that enemy unit). In addition, Blast weapons equipped by models in this unit can target enemy units within Engagement Range of this unit.

wargearAbilities.name: Icon of Despair
wargearAbilities.description: While an enemy unit is within 6" of the bearer, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1.

abilities.name: Curse of the Walking Pox
abilities.description: Each time a Poxwalker model in this unit makes an attack that destroys an enemy model (excluding Monster and Vehicle models), after this unit has resolved its attacks, you can return one destroyed Poxwalker model to this unit. While Typhus is leading this unit, enemy models destroyed as a result of Typhus' Eater Plague ability count as enemy models destroyed by an attack made by a Poxwalker model in this unit for the purposes of this ability.

abilities.name: Malicious Calculations
abilities.description: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristics and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Sevenfold Chant
abilities.description: In your Command phase, if this model is on the battlefield, roll 2D6: on a 7+, you gain 1CP.

leader.note: You can attach this model to a Plague Marines unit, even if one other Leader unit has already been attached to it (you cannot attach more than one of the same leader to the same unit). If you do, and that Bodyguard unit is destroyed, the Leader units attached to it become separate units, with their original Starting Strengths.

abilities.name: The Destroyer Hive
abilities.description: While this model is leading a unit, each time a melee attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Eater Plague
abilities.description: In your Shooting phase, you can select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this Psyker (excluding units with the Lone Operative ability that are not part of an Attached unit and are not within 12" of this Psyker) and roll one D6: on a 1, this Psyker's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.
